title: Conectores avançados
theme: Discourse markers (however, therefore, although, despite, furthermore, in conclusion)
goal: Student connects sentences and paragraphs at B2 level with mature discourse markers for contrast, cause, addition, and conclusion.
connects_to: Bridges into Advanced (C1) — formal register starts here.
module_chunks: in conclusion / to sum up / all in all

units.title: However
units.grammar_focus: Contrast markers — however, nevertheless, on the other hand
units.real_life_context: You introduce contrasting ideas formally in writing or measured speech.

grammar.sentence: I wanted to go. _____, I was too tired.
grammar.explanation: "However" introduz contraste formal entre duas frases. Vem no início, seguido de vírgula. Mais formal que "but".

grammar.sentence: The plan was risky. _____, we decided to proceed.
grammar.explanation: "Nevertheless" = apesar disso, mesmo assim. Contraste forte, formal. Sinônimo de "however" mas com ênfase em "apesar de".

grammar.sentence: She is intelligent. _____, she lacks experience.
grammar.explanation: Contraste entre qualidades. "However" liga duas observações opostas.

grammar.sentence: I love coffee. _____, my friend prefers tea.
grammar.explanation: "On the other hand" — outro lado/perspectiva. Contraste paralelo entre dois pontos de vista.

grammar.sentence: The product is expensive. _____, the quality is excellent.
grammar.hint: Conector de contraste no início de frase
grammar.explanation: "However" liga avaliações contrastantes. Comum em reviews ou análises.

grammar.sentence: The weather was bad. _____, we had fun.
grammar.explanation: "Nevertheless" — apesar de tudo. Contraste enfático.

grammar.sentence: He's introverted. _____, she's very outgoing.
grammar.hint: Contraste paralelo — On the other hand
grammar.explanation: "On the other hand" para comparação entre duas pessoas/coisas.

grammar.sentence: I love pizza, however, I can't eat it daily.
grammar.answer: I love pizza. However, I can't eat it daily.
grammar.explanation: "However" inicia nova oração, separada por ponto. Vírgula antes faz comma splice. Pontuação correta: ponto + However + vírgula.

grammar.sentence: However the weather, we went out.
grammar.answer: However, the weather was bad. We went out.
grammar.explanation: "However" sempre tem vírgula DEPOIS quando inicia oração. E não substitui "although" (que liga cláusulas).

grammar.passage: I wanted to go. However, I was too tired. The plan was risky. Nevertheless, we decided to proceed. She is intelligent. However, she lacks experience. I love coffee. On the other hand, my friend prefers tea.
grammar.question: Why didn't the speaker go?
grammar.explanation: The text says "However, I was too tired".

listening_speaking.text: I wanted to go. However, I was too tired.
Nevertheless, we decided to proceed.
On the other hand, she's outgoing.
The product is expensive. However, it's worth it.
He's quiet. On the other hand, his brother is loud.

units.title: Although, despite
units.grammar_focus: Concession — although/even though + clause; despite/in spite of + noun/-ing
units.real_life_context: You concede a point while introducing a contrast within one sentence.

grammar.sentence: _____ it was raining, we went out.
grammar.explanation: "Although + cláusula completa" (subject + verb). "Although it was raining" — concessão em uma frase só.

grammar.sentence: _____ the rain, we went out.
grammar.explanation: "Despite + noun" (sem cláusula). "Despite the rain" — só substantivo. Não pode "despite it was raining".

grammar.sentence: _____ being tired, she finished the project.
grammar.explanation: "Despite + -ing" funciona. "Despite being tired" — gerúndio.

grammar.sentence: _____ he is rich, he isn't happy.
grammar.explanation: "Although + sujeito + verbo". Cláusula completa.

grammar.sentence: _____ the difficulty, we succeeded.
grammar.explanation: "Despite the difficulty" — substantivo seguindo "despite".

grammar.sentence: _____ she's young, she's very mature.
grammar.explanation: "Although she's young" — cláusula completa após "although".

grammar.sentence: _____ having a bad day, he stayed kind.
grammar.explanation: "Despite having" — gerúndio após "despite". Equivalente a "in spite of having".

grammar.sentence: Despite it was raining, we went out.
grammar.answer: Despite the rain, we went out. (or: Although it was raining, we went out.)
grammar.explanation: "Despite + cláusula" é erro comum. Use "despite + noun/-ing" OU "although + cláusula completa".

grammar.sentence: Although the rain, we went out.
grammar.hint: "Although" precisa de cláusula com sujeito e verbo
grammar.answer: Although it was raining, we went out. (or: Despite the rain, we went out.)
grammar.explanation: "Although + substantivo" sozinho não funciona. Precisa de sujeito + verbo.

grammar.passage: Although it was raining, we went out. Despite the cold, we enjoyed the picnic. Although he is rich, he isn't happy. Despite being tired, she finished the project.
grammar.question: Why is the rich man not happy?
grammar.answer: he isn't happy (or "the text doesn't say why")
grammar.explanation: The text states "Although he is rich, he isn't happy" — the contrast is between wealth and happiness, no further reason given.

listening_speaking.text: Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the cold, we enjoyed it.
Even though he was tired, he kept going.
Despite being tired, she finished.
In spite of the difficulty, we succeeded.

units.title: Therefore, as a result
units.grammar_focus: Cause-result markers (therefore, consequently, as a result, for that reason)
units.real_life_context: You connect cause and consequence formally.

grammar.sentence: Sales dropped. _____, we cut the budget.
grammar.explanation: "Therefore" = portanto. Conecta causa e resultado lógico. Após ponto, com vírgula.

grammar.sentence: He missed the meeting. _____, he wasn't informed.
grammar.explanation: "As a result" = como resultado. Sinônimo informal de "therefore".

grammar.sentence: It rained heavily. _____, the road flooded.
grammar.explanation: "Consequently" = consequentemente. Formal, lógico.

grammar.sentence: She studied hard. _____, she passed.
grammar.explanation: Esforço → resultado. "Therefore she passed" — lógica de causa-efeito.

grammar.sentence: I overslept. _____, I missed the bus.
grammar.explanation: "As a result I missed" — consequência direta da ação anterior.

grammar.sentence: The project failed. _____, the team was disbanded.
grammar.explanation: Falha → dispersão. "Consequently" formal.

grammar.sentence: He's allergic to peanuts. _____, he avoids them.
grammar.explanation: "For that reason" = por essa razão. Conecta motivo a comportamento.

grammar.sentence: Sales dropped therefore we cut the budget.
grammar.answer: Sales dropped. Therefore, we cut the budget.
grammar.explanation: Conectores entre frases precisam de ponto antes e vírgula depois. Sem pontuação = comma splice.

grammar.sentence: He was sick, therefore he didn't come.
grammar.answer: He was sick. Therefore, he didn't come. (or: He was sick; therefore, he didn't come.)
grammar.explanation: Vírgula simples não é forte o bastante para "therefore". Use ponto ou ponto-e-vírgula.

grammar.passage: Sales dropped. Therefore, we cut the budget. He missed the meeting. As a result, he wasn't informed. It rained heavily. Consequently, the road flooded.
grammar.question: Why did the road flood?
grammar.explanation: The text says "It rained heavily. Consequently, the road flooded".

listening_speaking.text: Sales dropped. Therefore, we acted.
He missed it. As a result, he was uninformed.
It rained. Consequently, the event was canceled.
He's busy. For that reason, he can't come.
She studied hard. Therefore, she passed.

units.title: Furthermore, in addition
units.grammar_focus: Addition markers (furthermore, moreover, in addition, besides) and example markers (for instance, for example)
units.real_life_context: You build arguments by adding points and giving examples.

grammar.sentence: The course is intensive. _____, it's expensive.
grammar.explanation: "Furthermore" = além disso. Adiciona informação no mesmo sentido (não contraste).

grammar.sentence: She's a great manager. _____, she's a wonderful person.
grammar.explanation: "Moreover" = além disso. Adiciona qualidade adicional. Mais formal que "furthermore" mas similar.

grammar.sentence: He plays guitar. _____, he writes songs.
grammar.explanation: "In addition" = adicionalmente. Lista de habilidades/qualidades.

grammar.sentence: I don't want to go. _____, I have work to do.
grammar.explanation: "Besides" = além disso (informal, ofereço outra razão). Comum em conversação.

grammar.sentence: Brazil is huge. _____, it has many cultures.
grammar.explanation: "Furthermore" — adicionar outro fato no mesmo argumento.

grammar.sentence: Many fruits are healthy, _____ apples and oranges.
grammar.explanation: "Such as" introduz exemplos diretos após substantivo. Vírgula antes opcional.

grammar.sentence: I love hiking. _____, last weekend I climbed a mountain.
grammar.explanation: "For example" introduz exemplo concreto após generalização.

grammar.sentence: He's smart, furthermore he's funny.
grammar.explanation: Conectores formais entre orações pedem ponto antes, vírgula depois. Comma splice = incorreto.

grammar.sentence: For example, apples and oranges are healthy fruits.
grammar.hint: Frase precisa de contexto anterior — exemplo de quê?
grammar.answer: Many fruits are healthy. For example, apples and oranges are common choices.
grammar.explanation: "For example" precisa de uma afirmação geral antes para exemplificar. Sozinho fica solto.

grammar.passage: The course is intensive. Furthermore, it's expensive. She's a great manager. Moreover, she's a wonderful person. He plays guitar. In addition, he writes songs.
grammar.question: What does he do besides playing guitar?
grammar.explanation: The text says "He plays guitar. In addition, he writes songs".

listening_speaking.text: The course is intensive. Furthermore, it's expensive.
She's smart. Moreover, she's kind.
He plays guitar. In addition, he writes songs.
I don't want to go. Besides, I'm tired.
Fruits like apples and oranges are healthy. For example, apples have fiber.

units.title: In conclusion
units.grammar_focus: Conclusion markers (in conclusion, to sum up, all in all, overall) + integration
units.real_life_context: You wrap up arguments and integrate all discourse markers naturally.

grammar.sentence: _____, the project was a success.
grammar.explanation: "In conclusion" = em conclusão. Fecha argumento. Formal.

grammar.sentence: _____, it was a great experience despite the challenges.
grammar.explanation: "All in all" = no geral, considerando tudo. Informal, conclusivo.

grammar.sentence: _____, the report shows positive trends.
grammar.explanation: "To sum up" = para resumir. Apresenta conclusão concisa.

grammar.sentence: _____, I would recommend this approach.
grammar.explanation: "Overall" = no geral, em termos gerais. Conclusivo, opinativo.

grammar.sentence: _____, three points emerged from the discussion.
grammar.explanation: "To sum up" introduz síntese dos pontos.

grammar.sentence: _____, the year was challenging but rewarding.
grammar.explanation: "All in all" — balanço final ponderado.

grammar.sentence: _____, we should proceed with the launch.
grammar.explanation: "In conclusion" — decisão/recomendação formal.

grammar.sentence: In conclusion the project was successful.
grammar.answer: In conclusion, the project was successful.
grammar.explanation: "In conclusion" no início precisa de vírgula depois. Padrão universal de discourse markers iniciais.

grammar.sentence: All in all I learned a lot this year.
grammar.answer: All in all, I learned a lot this year.
grammar.explanation: "All in all" no início = comma obrigatória. Mesmo para conectores informais.

grammar.passage: In conclusion, the project was a success. To sum up, the report shows positive trends. All in all, it was a great experience. Overall, I would recommend this approach.
grammar.question: What is the speaker's overall recommendation?
grammar.explanation: The text says "Overall, I would recommend this approach".

listening_speaking.text: In conclusion, the project succeeded.
To sum up, three points stand out.
All in all, it was worthwhile.
Overall, I'd recommend it.
In summary, we exceeded expectations.

cross_unit_consolidation: Contraste: however, nevertheless, on the other hand, although, even though, despite, in spite of
Causa-efeito: therefore, consequently, as a result, for that reason
Adição: furthermore, moreover, in addition, besides
Exemplo: for example, for instance, such as
Conclusão: in conclusion, to sum up, all in all, overall, in summary
Pontuação: ponto antes do conector, vírgula depois (quando inicia oração)
Distinção: although + cláusula vs despite + noun/-ing
